_comment: Step 12 Y2 deployment scoring. v2 applies the conservative look/count/shape gate, the codebook rubric prompt, and a 2-line context window. It does not overwrite the previous Y2 workbooks.
_comment_output: New folder. Classrooms are still processed in sorted folder-name order, which is the order of the previous reports/y2_scores workbooks (Classroom49 keeps only the _updated folder). Each child sheet keeps the same sheet name, and remaining rows stay in transcript line_no order so a later human label joins on classroom + sheet + line_no.
_comment_context: Kept adult/child lines before and after the target, same transcript file only. Passed to the gpt-oss user message. The bi-encoder still embeds the target line alone.
_comment_gate: Before the LLM, and before a SCIENCE_TALK label, drop exact look-family, exact count/how-many, and exact shape/color utterances unless they are on the science-name hold-out. The 1-2 word length gate is not applied.
_comment_confidence: Drop transcription rows whose ASR confidence (the trailing (NN%)) is below this. Rows with no parsable confidence are kept.
_comment_top_k: Candidates re-ranked per utterance at deployment (smaller than the Step 10 default of 20 to stretch the LLM budget).
_comment_cost: Live ledger converts gpt-oss-120b calls to dollars and STOPS adding utterances to the LLM stage before dollar_cap. Remaining utterances keep their cosine score only.
_comment_thresholds: SCIENCE_TALK is assigned only when scored_by is llm and llm_score >= llm_label_threshold. Cosine-only rows stay NOT_SCIENCE_TALK and are omitted from science-only sheets. cosine_label_threshold is retained for reference and is not used to label.
_comment_science_only: When true, each per-child sheet contains ONLY utterances labeled SCIENCE_TALK (no-science child sheets are dropped, the SUMMARY sheet is omitted). Set false to write the full transcript with every kept utterance plus the SUMMARY sheet.
_comment_summary: Number of highest-scoring science utterances to surface on the per-workbook SUMMARY sheet (full-transcript mode only).
_comment_c49: Classroom49_012026 has _old / _updated / plain duplicates; keep only the folder ending in this suffix and skip the others.
